n = int(input())
b = int(input())
array = list(map(int, input().split()))
cost = [-1] * n

co = 0
ce = 0
cut = 0
coin = 0

for i in range(n):
    if array[i] % 2 == 0:
        ce += 1
    else:
        co += 1
    if co == ce and i != n - 1:
        if i != n - 1:
            cost[i] = abs(array[i + 1] - array[i])
        co = 0
        ce = 0

cost = [c for c in cost if c != -1]
cost.sort()

sum_cost = 0
for c in cost:
    if sum_cost + c > b:
        break
    sum_cost += c
    cut += 1

print(cut)
